sources.facts: Normalized o200k_base 16-token chained blocks; week-local block IDs and reconstructed session boundaries; provider reported token counts; nested subagents.
Same raw account ID maps to same keyed hash across releases using fixed salt; provider letters use stable private map. Validate release salt_series across all weeks before longitudinal aggregation.
BENCHMARK_HARNESS = eval:swe-bench; exclude for human-driven sensitivity.
Sticky routing preserves provider cache when feasible; session_id preferred routing, not unconditional availability.
Production switchback measured higher average cost alongside improved performance/reliability; cache-aware routing. No causal or welfare inference from our traces.
Fallback on error or rate limit unless restricted to one provider; subsequent requests remain on warm provider when possible.
Purchased credit expiry possible after 365 days; purchased/promotional credits may be used in provider-determined order.
PRO $2 monthly included inference credits; not dedicated switching grant.
Monthly free tier ceases after credit purchase; not unrestricted switching compensation.
Klemperer (1987), Markets with Consumer Switching Costs; existing IO theory.
Beggs and Klemperer (1992), Multi-period Competition with Switching Costs; repeated competition well-established.

estimands.event: One adjacent request pair, same model, provider change, previous observed hit >=90%, exact normalized prefix retention, valid nonoverlapping timing and token counts.
estimands.exposure: max(0,min(current prompt,previous cached)-current cached); also signed difference; no overlapping future work costs; not causal cache-miss attribution.
estimands.return: Provider previously observed in same reconstructed session and same model; check prior-route prefix and cached count; not actual same cache object or known voluntary multi-homing.
estimands.credits: One hypothetical dedicated credit per session/account-week/account across entire period; no ordinary consumption, no expiration; generic price-spread sensitivities and dated DeepSeek reference separately.

limitations: No actual account balance, supplier identity, private price, contract, grant, causal event reason, or behavior response. Human cohort excludes tagged benchmark, not independent individuals; no published account IDs. Distinguish financial exposure from actual market power.
